fusions.name: Settling Spores
fusions.desc: Shoots a cluster of spores that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Fairy Ring
fusions.desc: Caps open in a ring around you and shed spores, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each one [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Cultivated Bed
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a bed of caps beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds spores on enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Grows on Anything
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
